name: leadflow-erp
description: LeadFlow ERP — root tooling (git hooks + secret scanning)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.security:audit: npm --prefix server audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm --prefix client audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
scripts.security: npm run security:scan && npm run secret-scan && npm run security:audit
